parts.text: You are provided with two substances: solid A and solution B. Do the following tests on solid A and solution B. Record all of your observations at each stage. Tests on solid A

ms.label: 2(a)
ms.text:
M1 (solid / salt becomes) black
M2 condensation at top of tube

ms.label: 2(b)
ms.text:
M1 effervescence / fizzing / bubbles
M2 limewater becomes milky

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) The solution formed in 2(b) is solution C. Carefully pour solution C into a boiling tube while leaving the remaining solid behind. Divide solution C into three approximately equal portions in three test-tubes.

ms.label: 2(c)(i)
ms.text:
M1 (light) blue precipitate
M2 (precipitate) remains / does not dissolve / insoluble

ms.label: 2(c)(ii)
ms.text: no change / no reaction / no precipitate

ms.label: 2(c)(iii)
ms.text:
M1 deep blue (solution)
M2 (lighter) blue precipitate

ms.label: 2(d)
ms.text:
M1 copper(II) / Cu
2+
M2 carbonate / CO3
2–

parts.label: f
parts.text: (f) Divide the remaining solution B into two approximately equal portions in two test-tubes.

ms.label: 2(g)
ms.text:
M1 barium / Ba
2+
M2 chloride / Cl
–
